_source: http://prayer.covert.org/Sext/ — fetched 2026-08-27. These two devotions are NOT present in offices-data.js (which carries only the rubric naming them), so they are the one part of the bundled office text with no machine-checkable original. scripts/diff-office-text.py therefore cannot verify them; LittleHoursDatasetTests asserts them verbatim instead.

angelus.title: The Angelus

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: The Angel of the Lord announced unto Mary.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: And she conceived by the Holy Ghost.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Hail, Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now, and at the hour of our death.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: Be it unto me according to thy word.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Hail, Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now, and at the hour of our death.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: And the Word was made Flesh.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: And dwelt among us.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Hail, Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners now, and at the hour of our death.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

angelus.collect: WE beseech thee, O Lord, pour thy grace into our hearts: that, as we have known the Incarnation of thy Son Jesus Christ by the message of an Angel; so by his ✠ Cross and Passion we may be brought unto the glory of his Resurrection; through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord. Amen.

reginaCoeli.title: Regina Coeli

lines.text: O Queen of heaven, be joyful, alleluia;
Because he whom so meetly thou barest, alleluia,
Hath arisen, as he promised, alleluia:
Pray for us to the Father, alleluia.

lines.speaker: V
lines.text: Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia.

lines.speaker: R
lines.text: For the Lord is risen indeed, alleluia.

reginaCoeli.collect: O GOD, who, by the resurrection of thy Son Jesus Christ didst vouchsafe to give gladness unto the world: Grant, we beseech thee, that we, being holpen by the Virgin Mary, his Mother, may attain unto the joys of everlasting life. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
